mapper.select: SELECT bc.connection_id, bc.broker_id, bp.broker_code, bp.broker_name, bc.connection_status, bc.connected_at, bc.last_synced_at, COUNT(ia.connection_id) AS account_count FROM broker_connections bc JOIN broker_providers bp ON bp.broker_id = bc.broker_id LEFT JOIN investment_accounts ia ON ia.connection_id = bc.connection_id WHERE bc.user_id = #{userId} AND bc.connection_status != 'DISCONNECTED' GROUP BY bc.connection_id, bc.broker_id, bp.broker_code, bp.broker_name, bc.connection_status, bc.connected_at, bc.last_synced_at ORDER BY bc.connection_id

SELECT bc.connection_id, bc.broker_id, bp.broker_code, bp.broker_name, bc.connection_status, bc.connected_at, bc.last_synced_at, COUNT(ia.connection_id) AS account_count FROM broker_connections bc JOIN broker_providers bp ON bp.broker_id = bc.broker_id LEFT JOIN investment_accounts ia ON ia.connection_id = bc.connection_id WHERE bc.user_id = #{userId} AND bc.broker_id = #{brokerId} AND bc.connection_status = 'CONNECTED' GROUP BY bc.connection_id, bc.broker_id, bp.broker_code, bp.broker_name, bc.connection_status, bc.connected_at, bc.last_synced_at

SELECT bc.connection_id, bc.broker_id, bp.broker_code, bp.broker_name, bc.connection_status, bc.connected_at, bc.last_synced_at, COUNT(ia.connection_id) AS account_count FROM broker_connections bc JOIN broker_providers bp ON bp.broker_id = bc.broker_id LEFT JOIN investment_accounts ia ON ia.connection_id = bc.connection_id WHERE bc.connection_id = #{connectionId} AND bc.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY bc.connection_id, bc.broker_id, bp.broker_code, bp.broker_name, bc.connection_status, bc.connected_at, bc.last_synced_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO broker_connections (user_id, broker_id, source_type, mock_profile_code, connection_status, connected_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{brokerId}, 'MOCK', #{mockProfileCode}, 'CONNECTED', #{connectedAt})
